fr.label: Commercial·e
fr.description: Offres, relances, comptes rendus de rendez-vous, appels d'offres et suivi du pipeline.

en.label: Sales
en.description: Quotes, follow-ups, client meeting reports, tenders and pipeline tracking.

fr.text: Les prix, remises et délais viennent de votre grille ou de vos documents : l'agent n'en invente aucun et n'accorde rien de lui-même.

en.text: Prices, discounts and lead times come from your price list or your documents: the agent invents none and grants nothing on its own.

guardrails.agent: Never state a price, discount, payment term, lead time or warranty that is not in the documents, the request or the team's price-list note; when one is missing write « [à définir] » and list it under « Points to confirm ».

fr.text: Une offre ou un engagement envoyé au client vous engage : l'agent prépare, vous relisez et signez.

en.text: A quote or commitment sent to a client binds you: the agent prepares, you review and sign.

guardrails.agent: Draft every offer, commitment or concession for the person's signature; never word it as already approved by management, and list every commitment it makes under « Points to confirm ».

fr.text: Les informations sur un client ou un concurrent se limitent à ce que disent vos documents : pas de rumeur, pas de donnée personnelle superflue.

en.text: Information about a client or a competitor is limited to what your documents say: no rumours, no unnecessary personal data.

guardrails.agent: Use only facts about clients, contacts and competitors that are in the documents; do not speculate about a competitor's prices or a contact's private life, and keep personal data to name, function and business contact details.

fr.text: Dans un appel d'offres, les exigences et les délais du cahier des charges priment : l'agent les cite mot pour mot.

en.text: In a tender, the requirements and deadlines of the specification prevail: the agent quotes them word for word.

guardrails.agent: When working on a tender or a client's specification, quote every requirement, eligibility criterion, award criterion and deadline word for word with its section, and never claim the organisation meets a requirement unless the documents show it.

fr.label: Offre depuis un brief client
fr.hint: Pour quel client, quelle prestation ? Ex. « Offre pour la Fiduciaire Morand : maintenance annuelle de 25 postes »
fr.attach: La demande ou le brief du client, vos notes de rendez-vous, votre grille tarifaire
fr.produces: Une offre structurée : rappel du besoin, prestations, prix détaillés, conditions, validité et prochaine étape
checks: Les conditions de paiement et la durée de validité
Le nom et la fonction du destinataire

en.label: Quote from a client brief
en.hint: For which client, which service? E.g. “Quote for Fiduciaire Morand: annual maintenance of 25 workstations”
en.attach: The client's request or brief, your meeting notes, your price list
en.produces: A structured quote: the need restated, services, detailed prices, terms, validity and next step

templates.mission:
Write a commercial offer from the client's brief. What the person asked for: {subject}

Restate the client's need in the client's own words, then list the services offered as a table (item, quantity, unit price, total excl. VAT), taking every price from the price list or documents attached. Show subtotal, VAT and total as computed lines with their calculation. State validity, payment terms and lead time only as given; a need of the brief the offer does not cover is named, not ignored. End with one concrete next step (call, visit, signature).

fr.label: Relance d'une offre
fr.hint: Quelle offre, envoyée quand ? Ex. « Relancer l'offre 2026-041 envoyée au Garage Rochat le 28 octobre »
fr.attach: L'offre envoyée, les échanges depuis l'envoi
fr.produces: Un e-mail de relance court qui rappelle l'offre, apporte un élément utile et propose une suite simple
checks: La référence et la date de l'offre

en.label: Quote follow-up
en.hint: Which quote, sent when? E.g. “Follow up quote 2026-041 sent to Garage Rochat on 28 October”
en.attach: The quote sent, the exchanges since then
en.produces: A short follow-up e-mail recalling the quote, adding something useful and proposing a simple next step

templates.mission:
Draft the follow-up of a quote already sent. What the person asked for: {subject}

Refer to the quote by its number and date, recall in one sentence what it solves for the client, and answer any question raised in the exchanges since. Mention the validity deadline when the quote states one. Propose one easy next step (a 15-minute call, a date). Offer no new discount or condition unless the person's request gives it.

fr.label: Compte rendu de rendez-vous client
fr.hint: Quel client, quel jour ? Ex. « Compte rendu de la visite chez Menuiserie Dubois du 12 novembre »
fr.attach: Vos notes de rendez-vous, l'offre ou les documents présentés
fr.produces: Un compte rendu : participants, besoins exprimés, objections, décisions, actions et prochaine étape
checks: Les besoins et chiffres attribués au client
Les engagements pris de notre côté

en.label: Client meeting report
en.hint: Which client, which day? E.g. “Report of the visit to Menuiserie Dubois on 12 November”
en.attach: Your meeting notes, the quote or documents presented
en.produces: A meeting report: participants, needs expressed, objections, decisions, actions and next step
checks: Needs and figures attributed to the client

templates.mission:
Write the report of a client meeting from the notes attached. What the person asked for: {subject}

List participants with their function, then the client's situation and needs, budget and timing as stated, objections raised and how they were answered, and decisions. Separate what the client said from what we promised. Gather the actions in a table (action, owner, deadline) and state the next step and its date. Keep any figure or name the notes leave unclear marked as such.

fr.label: Préparation d'un rendez-vous
fr.hint: Quel client, quel objectif ? Ex. « Préparer le rendez-vous du 20 novembre avec la Clinique des Tilleuls, objectif : renouvellement »
fr.attach: L'historique du client (offres, comptes rendus, factures), sa demande, le site ou rapport du client
fr.produces: Une note d'une page : objectif, ce qu'on sait du client, questions à poser, objections probables, proposition
checks: Les faits sur le client et leur date

en.label: Meeting preparation
en.hint: Which client, which goal? E.g. “Prepare the 20 November meeting with Clinique des Tilleuls, goal: renewal”
en.attach: The client's history (quotes, reports, invoices), their request, the client's website or report
en.produces: A one-page note: goal, what we know about the client, questions to ask, likely objections, proposal
checks: Facts about the client and their date

templates.mission:
Prepare a briefing note for an upcoming client meeting. What the person asked for: {subject}

Start with the meeting's goal and the outcome to aim for. Summarise the relationship from the documents (past quotes, orders, open issues, with dates and amounts), then list 5 to 8 open questions to ask, the objections likely from the history and a short answer to each, and the proposal to make. Flag anything stale or contradictory in the history.

fr.label: Analyse d'un appel d'offres
fr.hint: Quel appel d'offres ? Ex. « Analyser l'appel d'offres de la commune pour l'entretien des espaces verts, délai 9 décembre »
fr.attach: Le cahier des charges, le règlement de l'appel d'offres, les annexes et formulaires
fr.produces: Une analyse : exigences et critères cités, délais, pièces à fournir, points bloquants, questions à poser et recommandation go / no-go
checks: Le délai de dépôt et les délais de questions
Les critères d'aptitude et d'adjudication avec leur pondération
Les points où nous ne remplissons pas une exigence

en.label: Tender analysis
en.hint: Which tender? E.g. “Analyse the town's tender for green-space maintenance, deadline 9 December”
en.attach: The specification, the tender rules, the annexes and forms
en.produces: An analysis: requirements and criteria quoted, deadlines, documents to provide, blocking points, questions to ask and a bid / no-bid recommendation
checks: The submission deadline and the question deadline
Eligibility and award criteria with their weighting
The points where we do not meet a requirement

templates.mission:
Analyse a call for tenders to prepare the bid / no-bid decision. What the person asked for: {subject}

Quote word for word, with section numbers, the submission deadline, the deadline for questions, the eligibility criteria, the award criteria and their weighting, and every mandatory document or form. In the review table, mark each requirement as met, not met or unknown based only on the documents. List the questions to send to the contracting authority and end with a bid / no-bid recommendation stated as an option for the person to decide.

fr.label: Pipeline depuis vos notes
fr.hint: Sur quelle période ? Ex. « Toutes les affaires en cours d'après mes notes d'octobre et novembre »
fr.attach: Vos notes de rendez-vous, e-mails, offres envoyées
fr.produces: Un tableau Excel : client, affaire, montant, étape, probabilité, prochaine action, échéance, source

en.label: Pipeline from your notes
en.hint: Over which period? E.g. “All open deals from my October and November notes”
en.attach: Your meeting notes, e-mails, quotes sent
en.produces: An Excel table: client, deal, amount, stage, probability, next action, deadline, source

templates.mission:
Build the sales pipeline from the notes attached. What the person asked for: {subject}

Columns: Client, Affaire, Montant (CHF HT), Étape (prospect / offre envoyée / négociation / gagnée / perdue), Probabilité (%), Prochaine action, Échéance, Source, À vérifier. One row per deal; when a deal appears in several notes keep the latest state and name every note in Source. Take probabilities from the team's stage scale when the memory has one, otherwise leave them empty. End with a total row of open amounts, labelled as computed.

fr.label: Réponse à une objection
fr.hint: Quelle objection, de qui ? Ex. « Le client trouve notre offre 15 % plus chère que la concurrence »
fr.attach: L'échange où l'objection est formulée, l'offre concernée, vos arguments ou références
fr.produces: Une réponse écrite qui reconnaît l'objection, répond par des faits et propose une suite
checks: Chaque argument chiffré et sa source
Les références clients citées (accord pour les nommer)

en.label: Objection reply
en.hint: Which objection, from whom? E.g. “The client finds our quote 15% more expensive than the competition”
en.attach: The exchange where the objection is raised, the quote concerned, your arguments or references
en.produces: A written reply that acknowledges the objection, answers with facts and proposes a next step
checks: Every figure-based argument and its source
Client references quoted (consent to name them)

templates.mission:
Draft a reply to a client's objection. What the person asked for: {subject}

Restate the objection fairly in one sentence, then answer it with facts from the documents (what the price includes, lead times, references, guarantees), never by criticising a competitor. If the objection is justified on a point, say so. Propose one next step; offer a concession only when the person's request authorises it, and state it exactly as authorised.

fr.label: Bilan d'un client clé
fr.hint: Quel client, quelle période ? Ex. « Bilan 2026 du client Boulangeries Perret avant la revue annuelle »
fr.attach: Les factures ou l'extrait du chiffre d'affaires, les offres, comptes rendus et réclamations
fr.produces: Un bilan : chiffre d'affaires par période, prestations, incidents, satisfaction, risques et opportunités

en.label: Key account review
en.hint: Which client, which period? E.g. “2026 review of Boulangeries Perret before the annual meeting”
en.attach: The invoices or revenue extract, quotes, meeting reports and complaints
en.produces: A review: revenue by period, services, incidents, satisfaction, risks and opportunities

templates.mission:
Write the review of a key account. What the person asked for: {subject}

Show revenue by period in a table with its source, and compute variations with the calculation shown. Summarise services bought, open quotes, incidents and complaints with their dates. Identify risks (dependence, dissatisfaction, contract end) and two to four opportunities grounded in the documents, each with the next step it would require.
